tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground and the scrim colour splash art fades into. Never place cards directly on pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default card fill (score cards, match list, insights, champion cards behind art).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Track behind pill navigation and segmented controls; fill of neutral notice boxes (MessageBox).

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Active nav pill, pressed segment, avatar fallback. Do not put ink-faint text on it.

tokens.name: surface-selected-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-highlight
tokens.usage: The one emphasised card per view (Queue readiness). Pair with border-highlight.

tokens.name: border-highlight
tokens.usage: 1px border of the surface-highlight card only.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows inside a card (match rows, ring contributors, also-played list).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of score rings and progress bars on surface.

tokens.name: track-strong
tokens.usage: Unfilled segments of the readiness meter on surface-highlight.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on every ground (≥13:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy, row labels and hero sub-text on every ground (≥9:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, meta lines, inactive nav text on every ground (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Chart axis labels and dates on bg, surface, surface-raised (≥5:1). Fails on surface-selected (4.3:1): use ink-muted there.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand purple for marks: score-ring fills, bars, readiness segments, win borders, active champion ring, trend line. Not for body text (4.5–5:1).

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Filled primary button background with on-primary text (7.1:1).

tokens.name: primary-strong-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary buttons (on-primary text 5.7:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary-strong buttons.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Strength chips.

tokens.name: positive-text
tokens.usage: Text meaning good: Victory, +LP, High, ▲ deltas, links (≥8:1).

tokens.name: positive-text-strong
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft chips.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs-work marks: score rings under 70, loss borders, negative bars. Always paired with a word or arrow.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text meaning needs work: Defeat, −LP, Low, ▼ deltas, Pattern/Trend chips (≥9:1).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Pattern and Trend chips.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Stat pills sitting on top of splash art.

tokens.name: spotlight
tokens.usage: Hover spotlight inside clickable cards (ChampionCard). Never on static cards.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px bg offset on every interactive element (10.8:1 on bg).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: System errors only (form validation, failed requests, destructive buttons): field border and message text, error icon. Never for match or performance meaning (use warn). 5.3:1 on bg, 5.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the error MessageBox; its text stays ink.

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of the error MessageBox.

tokens.name: winrate-terrible
tokens.usage: Win rate below 40%.

tokens.name: winrate-bad
tokens.usage: Win rate 40–47%.

tokens.name: winrate-average
tokens.usage: Win rate 48–52%.

tokens.name: winrate-good
tokens.usage: Win rate 53–59%.

tokens.name: winrate-great
tokens.usage: Win rate 60%+ (as a mark or 24px+ number).

tokens.name: rank-iron
tokens.usage: Iron tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-bronze
tokens.usage: Bronze tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-silver
tokens.usage: Silver tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-gold
tokens.usage: Gold tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-platinum
tokens.usage: Platinum tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-emerald
tokens.usage: Emerald tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-diamond
tokens.usage: Diamond tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-master
tokens.usage: Master tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-grandmaster
tokens.usage: Grandmaster tier badge.

tokens.name: rank-challenger
tokens.usage: Challenger tier badge.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: The single hero number of a card (Queue readiness).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: One plain-language headline per page, in the hero.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Champion name on a champion card.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Win rate or key stat beside a name.

styles.name: insight
styles.usage: Insight card title and match-row LP change.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Most of your Ahri losses come from deaths after 25 minutes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Call it after your next loss.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Insight bodies, row labels, nav links (500).

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Champion name in a match row or list.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a highlight card's number.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under names, card sub-titles.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip labels and chart axis labels (400).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside pill tracks, between stacked label and value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and text, title and body.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a card's content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Insight card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Standard card padding and gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop (16px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Readiness meter segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Square champion icons (44px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Insight cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards: score, champion, list, highlight.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Champion hero only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav pills, segments, chips, round portraits.

shadow.note: The system is flat: depth comes from surface steps, not shadows. The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element.
